capabilities: create slide-like presentations from canvas nodes
customize nodes and edges with shapes, border styles and pathfinding methods
embed canvases as portals and link or embed single nodes into markdown files
annotate PDF pages within the canvas
export canvases as PNG or SVG images
extras: The Alternative Text Rendering feature changes how Obsidian renders markdown in canvas text nodes and is disabled by default; variable breakpoints are cached and only reload when the canvas is reopened.
intentEvidence: This plugin enhances the Obsidian canvas with a wide array of features
problem: Obsidian's core Canvas lacks presentation mode, flowchart shapes, frontmatter support, metadata-cache indexing and finer control over nodes, edges and readonly mode.
summary: Canvas enhancement plugin that adds presentations, flowchart shapes, portals, PDF annotation, metadata-cache indexing and image export to Obsidian's canvas.
